mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions: plain HTTP is not permitted for internal hosts, and internal traffic is held to the same HTTPS requirement as any other.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md
